meta_title: BWS Plumbing & Heating | Emergency Plumber Guildford

hero_subhead: Burst pipe or boiler breakdown in Guildford? We arrive within an hour, any time of day or night.

services.title: Emergency Plumbing Callouts
services.desc: Burst pipes, leaking radiators, and blocked drains fixed fast. We carry common parts and aim to resolve most issues the same day.

services.title: Central Heating Maintenance

about_pullquote: I started this business because I saw too many people being overcharged by unreliable plumbers.
about_para_1: BWS Plumbing & Heating Ltd has served Guildford and the surrounding areas for over 15 years. Founded on the belief that customers deserve honest pricing and reliable service, we've built our reputation on turning up on time, doing the job right, and explaining everything clearly. Every member of our team is Gas Safe registered and fully trained in both emergency and planned work.
about_para_2: Our customers choose us because we answer the phone, we show up when we promise, and we don't leave a mess. We've completed over 2,000 jobs across Guildford — everything from midnight burst pipes to planned boiler installations — and we take pride in the fact that most of our work comes from referrals and repeat customers. Whether it's a quick fix or a major project, you'll get the same attention and fair pricing.
reviews_heading: What Guildford Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Pipe burst at 11pm on a Sunday. Called BWS and they were here by midnight. Really professional bloke, fixed it properly, and didn't charge a fortune like some do. Top service, will use again.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: New boiler installation from start to finish. The lads turned up on time, explained everything as they went, and cleaned up after themselves. Proper job. Can't fault them.
reviews.author: Catherine H.

reviews.text: Had our radiators balanced and a few leaks sorted. Quick visit, fair price, and they answered every question we had. You can tell they actually care about doing good work.
reviews.author: David P.
